title: Knowledge Check
subtitle: Finish your journey

cards.title: Almost there, {name}!
cards.body: Let's check what you have learned. Answer the questions in the next step – you need 80% to receive your certificate. You can try as many times as you like.

questions.question: In which year was Our Credo written?
According to Our Credo, who comes first?
options: Patients, doctors, nurses and all who use our products and services

questions.question: Which two areas does Johnson & Johnson focus on today?
Which business unit includes electrophysiology, heart pumps and Shockwave?
In October 2025, J&J announced its intent to separate which business?
What does the business-unit-led operating model mean?
options: Business units own strategy and results end to end
Every decision is made at headquarters

questions.question: Which standard describes quality management systems for medical devices?
Validation answers which question?
options: Did we build the product right?
Did we build the right product for the users' needs?

questions.question: A customer mentions a possible problem with one of our products. What do you do?
options: Wait to see if it happens again
Report it promptly as a potential complaint, following our procedure
Tell them to contact a competitor
Ignore it if you are not in Quality

questions.question: You see a near miss at the site. What should you do?
options: Fix it and tell no one

nextSteps: Complete your required training in the learning system.
Meet your onboarding buddy and your manager's team.
Keep this file – you can revisit any station at any time.
certificateText: has completed the J&J MedTech New Employee Journey, covering our company, Our Credo, our business units, our organisation, medical technology fundamentals, our products and our site.
